coverage_disposition: Existing rule family; retain as a regression anchor
witness: One key appears twice in A and three times in B, with distinct non-key column names. The documented match-merge produces three rows; an equijoin produces six. Compare row content as well as count.
proposed_control: Validate key multiplicity and source order before choosing a target join. Do not call pandas validate='many_to_many' a cardinality check: that setting permits the case without checking uniqueness.

coverage_disposition: Existing family; engine-specific combinations need explicit scope
witness: Join tables containing ordinary missing keys, different special-missing tags, zero, and a negative value. Separately test a missing value as an IF condition and as a relational operand.
proposed_control: Write separate contracts for truth, ordering, equality, grouping, and joins. Retain missing tags until the consumer's policy is chosen. Avoid the blanket claim that all missing comparisons are false.

coverage_disposition: Existing primitives; whole-step composition needs validation
witness: Use a one-row lookup read only when _N_=1, then process three observations from a second input. The lookup value should remain available on later iterations; a scratch assignment without retention needs a separate expectation.
proposed_control: Model variable origin, initialization, step boundaries, and reset points. Validate conditional SET separately from a dataframe join or a global dictionary.

coverage_disposition: Adjacent coverage; explicit filter-order witness proposed
witness: For one group with rows keep=0 then keep=1, compare WHERE keep=1 followed by FIRST.key with subsetting IF keep=1 followed by FIRST.key. Only the WHERE version makes the surviving row the first row of its filtered group.
proposed_control: Preserve the sequence of input selection, group formation, state changes, and output. Do not push a filter upstream merely as an optimization.

coverage_disposition: Dedicated output-cardinality fixture proposed
witness: A single iteration assigns x=4, outputs, assigns x=9, and outputs again. Expect two rows, 4 and 9, with no additional automatic row. A conditionally skipped OUTPUT may yield no row.
proposed_control: Represent output as an event, not a final dataframe snapshot. Compare destination datasets, emission order, row multiplicity, and values at each output point.

coverage_disposition: Existing text family; transcoding and schema-order frontier
witness: Assign a short literal before a longer literal, then repeat with a declared length before the first assignment. Separately test multibyte text during encoding conversion with a fixed storage width.
proposed_control: Capture type, length, encoding, declaration order, and truncation behavior. Do not silently widen columns while claiming exact legacy behavior; classify widening as a deliberate correction if desired.

coverage_disposition: Corrected rule and target gate exist; expand composition cases
witness: On values 10,20,30,40, invoke one LAG occurrence only on rows two and four. Expected returns at those invocations are missing and 20, rather than 10 and 30 from an unconditional shift.
proposed_control: Distinguish conditional invocation from conditional use of an unconditional result. Include two independent occurrences, missing arguments, LAG2, and explicit group reset logic in the next fixtures.

coverage_disposition: Existing family; explicit ordering and engine conditions remain necessary
witness: Give two equal keys different payloads, then reverse input order. Under explicit EQUALS the retained payload should follow the first input row. Repeat with the actual input engine rather than assuming its read order.
proposed_control: Pin BY order, EQUALS/NOEQUALS, collation, and tie-breakers. Compare retained row identities, not just the number of unique keys.

coverage_disposition: Existing rule; downstream row-count consequences need end-to-end witnesses
witness: For two rows in a group with values 2 and 6, select the group, the detail value, and its group mean. A remerge can retain two rows with a mean of 4 on each.
proposed_control: Translate the documented shape with a window operation or aggregate-plus-join after checking nulls and duplicates. Adding a detail column to GROUP BY can change the statistic rather than repair it.

coverage_disposition: Duplicate handling corrected; naming collisions and missing IDs are expansion targets
witness: Choose two distinct raw IDs that format to the same label, then values whose normalized output names collide. Test with and without LET and include a missing ID.
proposed_control: Validate names after formatting and normalization. Do not replace duplicate handling with an averaging pivot. Compare schema, selected value, warning status, and row loss.

coverage_disposition: Existing format primitives; procedure-option combinations need review
witness: Map raw codes 1 and 2 to one label, then compare formatted grouping with GROUPINTERNAL. Add a missing class and an unobserved preloaded level as distinct cases.
proposed_control: Carry the format catalog and procedure options through conversion. Compare group membership, zero-count levels, counts, and the output representative value separately.

coverage_disposition: Half-away reference exists; fuzzing neighborhood remains a separate contract
witness: Test positive and negative half-unit boundaries, nearby representable numbers, and a non-decimal rounding unit. Include exact ties and near ties separately.
proposed_control: Name the SAS function, unit, numeric domain, and comparison tolerance. Do not infer full equivalence from a few decimal examples or substitute string formatting for arithmetic.

coverage_disposition: Existing INTCK/INTNX family; options and parsing remain explicit
witness: Compare January 31 to February 1 using month intervals: the discrete count is one while the continuous count is zero. Add leap-day and month-end cases before selecting a target offset operation.
proposed_control: Record epoch, units, interval, method, alignment, and date-parsing policy. Keep INTNX alignment tests separate; an INTCK result does not validate INTNX SAME.

related_rules: DS-021 adjacent; raw INPUT is a separate surface
coverage_disposition: New raw-record boundary fixtures proposed
witness: Read records '1', '22', and '33333' with a five-column numeric informat under each end-of-record option. Record both resulting values and the number of consumed physical lines.
proposed_control: Inventory INPUT style, informats, delimiters, quoting, line endings, and INFILE options. Distinguish raw-record parsing from PROC IMPORT type guessing; both require their own fixture.

coverage_disposition: Known corrected weight behavior; broaden procedure contrasts
witness: Use nonmissing responses paired with positive, zero, negative, and missing weights. Compare N, total weight, mean, and variance under explicit VARDEF and EXCLNPWGT choices.
proposed_control: Write the estimator formula and inclusion mask before choosing a library function. Match response-missing handling separately; agreement on the mean does not establish variance or degrees-of-freedom parity.

coverage_disposition: Existing mapping; weighted and approximate paths need separate scope
witness: For sorted values 0,10,20,30 at p=0.25, R type 7 gives 7.5 while type 2 gives 5. This is a target-algorithm illustration, not a universal mapping for every SAS procedure.
proposed_control: Select the actual SAS procedure, definition, exact/approximate method, and weight contract first. Verify any R or Python mapping on ties, small samples, endpoints, and missing values.

coverage_disposition: Rulebook covers settings; model-specific validation still required
witness: Fit the same two-level predictor with event 1 versus event 0 and with both reference levels. Inspect the response profile and design matrix before comparing coefficients.
proposed_control: Pin event, reference levels, parameterization, analysis rows, weights, and convergence conditions. Compare predictions and named contrasts as well as coefficient arrays.

coverage_disposition: Existing survey routing; verify variance design explicitly
witness: Use a multi-stratum clustered sample with a domain absent from some clusters. Compare raw-data filtering with domain estimation on the full design and examine standard errors and degrees of freedom.
proposed_control: Build the complete survey design first and use its domain operation. Pin strata, clusters, finite-population corrections, replicate scaling, and singleton handling rather than replacing the analysis with weighted means.

coverage_disposition: Existing stochastic policy; per-generator validation required
witness: Generate normals and uniforms from equal integer seeds in the chosen runtimes. Treat unequal draws as expected unless an exact shared algorithm contract has been implemented.
proposed_control: For stochastic equivalence, predeclare distributional diagnostics and tolerances. For exact replay, capture or specify the complete stream and transformation contract. Do not tune tests until unrelated streams happen to match.

coverage_disposition: Existing interchange policy; catalog and encoding round trips need witnesses
witness: Round-trip an identifier with leading zeros, a labeled value, a special missing tag, a date value, and multibyte text. Compare typed values and metadata separately.
proposed_control: Retain a reviewed metadata sidecar with the converted table. Validate labels, format names, missing tags, widths, and encoding; do not claim Parquet alone preserves every SAS attribute.

coverage_disposition: Engine-mode frontier; no blanket Base SAS to CAS claim
witness: Read .A, ordinary missing, blank text, and null through both declared modes. Compare equality predicates, joins, and the values written back to a SAS table.
proposed_control: Record execution engine, connection path, mode, and data-source types. Do not treat PROC SQL, PROC FEDSQL, remote pass-through SQL, and CAS execution as one language implementation.

coverage_disposition: Existing array semantics; declaration order and retention need composition tests
witness: Declare an array over x and y, assign through the second element, and inspect y. Then assign y directly and inspect that array element; a copied Python list will not reproduce both directions automatically.
proposed_control: Preserve aliasing, bounds, variable order, and initialization lifetime. Resolve special variable lists against the correct compile-time schema.

coverage_disposition: Operational acceptance beyond numeric fixtures
witness: Run two interactive procedure steps with an ODS OUTPUT request between them, then repeat with an explicit QUIT and correctly scoped request. Check actual dataset creation rather than the printed report.
proposed_control: Declare required datasets, schemas, log conditions, and procedure lifecycle. Treat missing artifacts as failures even when the job process finishes. Separate output suppression from preventing object generation.

coverage_disposition: Existing human-review/statistical routing; compare full model specification
witness: Use unbalanced repeated measurements, specify an unstructured residual covariance, and compare the fitted covariance and named treatment contrast with an independently specified target model.
proposed_control: Pin covariance structure, ML/REML or likelihood approximation, degrees-of-freedom method, contrasts, optimizer, and convergence checks. Compare estimands and covariance parameters before relaxing numeric tolerances.

coverage_disposition: Existing survival family; tied-event and risk-set fixtures needed
witness: Use tied event times plus censoring and compare explicitly selected Breslow and Efron fits. Add delayed entry as a separate risk-set test rather than assuming right-censoring coverage includes it.
proposed_control: Pin tie method, event/censor coding, time scale, entry/exit intervals, strata, and baseline-survival method. Assess risk sets and log likelihood before comparing coefficients.
